GoalOptions.Label: Enable AI/ML Innovation
GoalOptions.Text: The primary goal is to enable the client to leverage differentiated AI/ML capabilities across multiple hyperscalers, fostering innovation and accelerating data-intensive workload development. Success means a clear pathway for integrating specialized AI/ML services from a secondary provider like GCP, complementing existing Azure strengths.

GoalOptions.Label: Enhance Cloud Resilience
GoalOptions.Text: This document aims to enhance the client's cloud resilience and reduce vendor concentration risk by strategically integrating a secondary hyperscaler. Success will be measured by improved workload portability and a diversified cloud footprint that minimizes dependency on a single provider for critical AI/ML and data services.

GoalOptions.Label: Ensure Governance Alignment
GoalOptions.Text: A key goal is to ensure that the proposed multi-cloud strategy for AI/ML and data workloads aligns seamlessly with existing Azure governance and platform engineering capabilities. Success means the extension of current robust controls and policies to the new hyperscaler environment, maintaining a unified and secure operational posture.

GoalOptions.Label: Optimize Cloud Investment
GoalOptions.Text: The objective is to optimize cloud investment by strategically adopting a multi-cloud approach for specialized AI/ML and data services. Success involves achieving enhanced innovation and scalability while ensuring cost-effectiveness and avoiding unnecessary duplication of effort or resources across cloud providers.

CriteriaOptions.Label: Technical & Architectural Soundness
Criteria: The proposed multi-cloud architecture clearly defines integration points and data flow for AI/ML workloads.
The strategy ensures seamless extension of existing Azure platform engineering practices to the secondary hyperscaler.
Workload portability mechanisms between cloud environments are well-articulated and technically feasible.
The document addresses potential technical debt or complexity introduced by multi-cloud adoption.

CriteriaOptions.Label: Compliance & Audit Readiness
Criteria: The strategy explicitly outlines how existing compliance frameworks (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA) will extend to the multi-cloud environment.
Audit trails and logging mechanisms across both hyperscalers are defined for AI/ML data processing.
Data residency and sovereignty requirements for sensitive AI/ML datasets are addressed.
The document identifies key controls and policies for managing access and security in the multi-cloud setup.

CriteriaOptions.Label: Strategic & Business Impact
Criteria: The strategy clearly articulates how multi-cloud adoption directly supports the client's AI/ML innovation roadmap.
The document quantifies or qualitatively describes the reduction in vendor concentration risk.
The phased adoption approach is practical and aligns with business priorities and resource availability.
The strategy demonstrates a clear return on investment (ROI) or strategic advantage for the multi-cloud transition.
